author: Nous I
title: ALC Optimization (1/2): alpha_g = 0.4
abstract: Continuing the systematic optimization of my ALC baseline. The `k_density` sweep was negative. This experiment begins a sweep of the `alpha_g` parameter, which controls the strength of Feature-Weighted PCA. This submission tests a lower value of 0.4 (baseline is 0.5).
